title: Design System: The Gridiron Grand Gambit Gala

stat.purpose: Tabular figures in stat cards and columns.

label.purpose: Tracked uppercase eyebrows, stat labels, pills.

shadows.name: outline-xs
shadows.purpose: Outline buttons only; the sole resting shadow.

motion.purpose: Sheets and popovers; 500ms in / 300ms out for the drawer, 150ms default.

components.name: Position Pill
components.html: QB RB WR

components.name: Note

narrative.overview: GGGG is a working reporter's booth above the field: a warm, low-lit room of hairline rules, tabular numbers and one tan accent for the on-air graphics. Information density is a feature. Managers come mid-game on a phone, so every surface is a scannable sheet of figures rather than a showpiece. Personality comes from the broadcast voice and the precision of the details, not from decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-dark ground. Tan marks you and what you can tap; green, amber, red and violet carry meaning; one loud red belongs to the punishment.
Axis Extrabold for headings, team names in the standings and the leading score; Archivo with tabular figures for everything else.
Real headings (sentence case, 20-24px) instead of tiny tracked labels. Caps are for table column heads only.
Flat hairline surfaces, no side stripes; lift reserved for live state.
Per-team accent (--team) can tint a page when a manager picks their team.

rules.name: The Tan Means You Rule
rules.body: Tan is for what you can tap and what is yours. It does not mark section headings, banners, sorted columns or leading scores. Green, amber, red and violet carry meaning and never decorate.

rules.name: The Team Tint Rule
rules.body: A picked team's color arrives only through `--team`, which falls back to Press Tan. Never hardcode a franchise color in a page.

rules.name: The Token Rule
rules.body: No hex literals in components. Every color is a token from `web/app/globals.css`.

rules.name: The Chyron Rule
rules.body: Axis is for headings, the twelve team names in the standings and the leading score of a matchup: a signature, not a texture. It never sets a table cell of figures, a label or a badge.

rules.name: The Column Rule
rules.body: Any figure that sits in a column uses Archivo's tabular numerals so digits align.

rules.name: The Live Lift Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Only modules that show live game-day state (in-progress matchups, live win probability, the week pulse) may lift or glow to mark "now." Once the games end, they go flat again.

rules.name: The One Loud Rule
rules.body: --punish is the league's own colour, used large once per page for the leader's odds of the punishment.

dos: **Do** set every color from tokens in `web/app/globals.css`, including `--ok`/`--warn`/`--bad`/`--info` for meaning.
**Do** use Axis only through `font-brand` on headings.
**Do** reuse `components/gggg/primitives.tsx` (StatCard, PageHeader, PosPill, Headshot, Note) and `Segmented` rather than restyling inline.
**Do** check dark and light mode; card stays lighter than the page in both.
**Do** give every animation a static end state and honor `prefers-reduced-motion`.
**Do** keep every piece of text at 11px or larger and secondary text at 4.5:1 or better.
donts: **Don't** put Axis on columns of figures, labels, badges or table cells.
**Don't** add a second brand color, or use the semantic colors as decoration.
**Don't** use drop shadows to separate resting surfaces; reserve lift for live modules.
**Don't** default to light mode or follow `prefers-color-scheme`; dark is the house default.
**Don't** hardcode hex values or franchise colors in a page.
**Don't** use a colored side border on a card, note, row or cell.
**Don't** put a tracked-caps label above a page title or heading.
